activities.title: Quick check: a memo you've never seen

blocks.prompt: The AI draft cites "Memorandum Order No. 2026-117". You've never seen it. What do you do?
options: Keep it. It makes the letter sound official.
Ask the AI, "Is this memo real?"
Look for it in an official source; delete it if you can't find it.
Change the number slightly so it looks less copied.

activities.title: Module 2 Quiz: Word Processing
activities.intro: 10 items, 1 point each. Pick the one best answer for each item. Everything on it was covered in Topics 2.1 to 2.6.

blocks.prompt: 1. You must email a finished letter so it looks the same on every computer and is not edited. Which format do you send?
2. Which file name follows the Type - Subject - Date habit?
3. Which shortcut finds a word and replaces it everywhere in the document?
4. You want every heading to look the same, and to change them all at once later. What do you use?
options: Bold and a bigger font, heading by heading
Spaces to push each heading to the centre

blocks.prompt: 5. In a table, which key moves you to the next cell?
6. The office logo should appear at the top of every page of the letter. Where do you put it?
options: On page 1, with Behind Text wrapping
As the first line of the body text

blocks.prompt: 7. What are the three parts of a mail merge?
options: Main document, data source and merge fields

blocks.prompt: 8. Your office prints on long bond paper. Which paper size do you set?
options: Whatever the printer chose last time

blocks.prompt: 9. Which prompt gives the AI the best start on a workshop invitation?
options: You are an admin officer. Write a one-page formal letter inviting section staff to a digital skills workshop on 19 November 2026. Warm and polite.
Make it sound good and professional, please.
Copy a good invitation from the internet.

blocks.prompt: 10. The AI draft still says "Dear [Insert Name]" and cites a memo you have never seen. What do you do before sending?
options: Ask the AI whether the memo is real
Fill in the real names, and check the memo in an official source or delete it
Add a line saying AI wrote it
